description: This is a Java source file defining a Logger utility class that encapsulates logging functionality, including different log levels and chaining LogNodes for log message processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing LogNode chains, and defining log level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode to which logs are delegated.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode instance that will handle log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
